title: The Library Dust in the Sun Slice
youtube_title: The Library Dust in the Sun Slice | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Lior finds a slice of sun in the library aisle. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Lior shows Bram how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
